game.name: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals

features:
🐾 Creatures Tab
Food & Drink: Auto Eat, Auto Drink, Food Selector.
Infinite Stats: Infinite Stamina, Oxygen, Charge, Moisture.
Utility: Wall Climber, Auto Cower, Auto Hide Scent, Anti-Tornado, Anti-Weather, Anti-Action Block, Anti-Lava.
AFK Mode: Auto fly, eat, drink, and elder with customizable height, thresholds, and Elder Types (Powerful / Gentle / Devious).

⚔️ Combat Tab
Combat: Target Selector, Damage Aura, Aura Range Slider, Auto Aggression.
Advanced ⚠️: Kill All Players, Kill All Resources.
Resource Farming: Resource Aura, Range Slider.
Survival: Anti-Death, Fast Turn, Turn Speed Slider.

🤖 Auto Farm Tab
Farming: Auto Collect Shooms, Reset Shoom Data.
Gacha Tokens: Auto Collect Gacha.
Food Farming: Food Selector, Refresh Food List, Auto Grab & Drop Food.
Shrine Donations: Donation Selector, Auto Donate to all 8 Shrines.
Auto Farm Kill: Patrol kill zones and attack automatically.

👁️ ESP Tab
Display: Names, Boxes, Tracers, Distance, Health, Text Size.
ESP: Players ESP, Food ESP, Lakes ESP, NPC ESP, Gacha ESP.

📦 Misc Tab
Movement: Noclip, Fly (adjustable speed), Speed Hack.
Anti-AFK: Prevent AFK kicks.
Fast Gacha: Skip Gacha animations instantly.
Party: Create Party & Invite All.
Server Tools: Server Info, Join by Job ID, Random Hop, Best Ping Hop, Small Server Finder, Rejoin Server.

📍 Teleport Tab
Player Teleport: Player Selector, Refresh List, Teleport To Player.
Map Teleport: Click Teleport (Ctrl + Click), Auto Map Teleport, Warp to Pinned Locations.

⚙️ Settings Tab
Graphics: Normal / Low / Potato.
Volume: Boost up to 300%.
Game Codes: Redeem codes directly.
Config: Save Config, Reset Config, Destroy GUI.
